from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import base64, json, zlib

ROOT=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
TASK="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-POSTBUILD-20261006-R3-P2"
env=json.loads((ROOT/"model_results"/(TASK+".json")).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
cp=(ROOT/env["checkpoint"]).resolve()
complete=json.loads((cp/"COMPLETE.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
final=complete.get("final")
review=json.loads(final) if isinstance(final,str) else final
payload={
 "candidate_id":review.get("candidate_id"),
 "phase":review.get("phase"),
 "binding_sha256":review.get("binding_sha256"),
 "decision":review.get("decision"),
 "finding":review.get("finding"),
 "next_action":review.get("next_action")
}
raw=json.dumps(payload,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
data=base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(raw,9)).decode("ascii")
meta={"schema":"PREDICTION_ASTRA_FEEDBACK_EXPORT_V1","encoding":"zlib+base64","chars":len(data)}
print("PREDICTION_SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_V1")
print("SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_META="+json.dumps(meta,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True))
print("SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_DATA="+data)
